jsonData.disclaimer: Research-grounded, NOT legal advice. Confirm exact OJ/EUR-Lex wording, the per-market language matrix, national derogations, and Reg (EU) 2026/471 specifics with counsel before shipping label copy (see docs/elabel/PRD.md §11.3).

nutrition.energyOnlyOnLabelDerogation: FIC Art 30(4) — alcoholic beverages >1.2% may limit the on-pack nutrition to energy value only.

language.rule: FIC Art 15 — a language easily understood by consumers of the marketing Member State; a Member State may require its national language. 24 is a practical upper bound, NOT a legal cap.

qr.basis: FIC Art 18(1) — a text heading containing 'Ingredients' (localised) is required; a generic 'i' symbol is insufficient.

eLabelPageRules.basis: Recital of Reg (EU) 2021/2117 + Commission Notice C/2023/1190.

dealcoholised.partiallyDeAlcoholised: > 0.5% vol and below the wine-category minimum
dealcoholised.durabilityDate: Minimum-durability date mandatory for de-alcoholised wines < 10% ABV (ordinary wine >= 10% is exempt).
dealcoholised.note: EU wine regime has no '<=0.05% alcohol-free' wine category; terms are 'de-alcoholised' (<=0.5%) and 'partially de-alcoholised'. Reg (EU) 2026/471 allows PDO/PGI retention.

wine.basis: Reg (EU) 2021/2117 overrides the FIC Art 16(4) >1.2% ABV exemption for wine / aromatised-wine products.
wine.effective: Wine from the 2024 harvest; wine produced before 2023-12-08 grandfathered until stocks exhausted.

sparkling_wine.basis: Reg (EU) 2021/2117 overrides the FIC Art 16(4) >1.2% ABV exemption for wine / aromatised-wine products.
sparkling_wine.effective: Wine from the 2024 harvest; wine produced before 2023-12-08 grandfathered until stocks exhausted.

fortified_wine.basis: Reg (EU) 2021/2117 overrides the FIC Art 16(4) >1.2% ABV exemption for wine / aromatised-wine products.
fortified_wine.effective: Wine from the 2024 harvest; wine produced before 2023-12-08 grandfathered until stocks exhausted.

vermouth.basis: Aromatised wine product under Reg (EU) 251/2014; 2021/2117 removed the FIC exemption. Ingredient designation per Delegated Reg (EU) 2024/585.
vermouth.effective: Wine from the 2024 harvest; wine produced before 2023-12-08 grandfathered until stocks exhausted.

flavored_wine.basis: 'Flavoured & fruit wine' (HS 2206) is NOT a grapevine product nor a Reg (EU) 251/2014 aromatised-wine product, so it stays FIC-exempt (>1.2% ABV) → e-label voluntary. The grape-based aromatised-wine regime (mandatory) is the 'vermouth' category. Confirm per-product if a fruit/flavoured product is in fact grape-wine-based.
flavored_wine.nationalRulesNote: Member States may keep national ingredient-list rules for alcoholic beverages (e.g. Germany mandates an ingredient list on beer) — needs a country-by-country layer.

beer.basis: FIC Art 16(4) exempts beverages >1.2% ABV from the mandatory ingredient list + nutrition declaration; the e-label is voluntary industry practice.
beer.nationalRulesNote: Member States may keep national ingredient-list rules for alcoholic beverages (e.g. Germany mandates an ingredient list on beer) — needs a country-by-country layer.

allergens.note: Annex II item 1 exempts cereals used for distillates — NOT beer.

spirits.basis: Reg (EU) 2019/787 added no mandatory ingredient/nutrition declaration; e-label voluntary (spiritsEUROPE 'U-label'). Cereals used for distillates are NOT a declarable allergen.
spirits.nationalRulesNote: Member States may keep national ingredient-list rules for alcoholic beverages (e.g. Germany mandates an ingredient list on beer) — needs a country-by-country layer.

cider_mixed_drinks.basis: FIC Art 16(4) exempts beverages >1.2% ABV from the mandatory ingredient list + nutrition declaration; the e-label is voluntary industry practice.
cider_mixed_drinks.nationalRulesNote: Member States may keep national ingredient-list rules for alcoholic beverages (e.g. Germany mandates an ingredient list on beer) — needs a country-by-country layer.

non_alcoholic.basis: At or below 1.2% ABV the FIC >1.2% exemption falls away — full food labelling applies.
non_alcoholic.note: Distinct from de-alcoholised WINE (a grapevine product — see top-level `dealcoholised`).

other.basis: Unspecified category — treated as FIC-exempt/voluntary by default; classify before relying on this.
other.nationalRulesNote: Member States may keep national ingredient-list rules for alcoholic beverages (e.g. Germany mandates an ingredient list on beer) — needs a country-by-country layer.

jsonData.description: Curated operating markets. Gates tenders.target_country, markets.country and organizations.country. Narrower than country_codes by design — this is a commercial policy list, not a geographic one.
Producer offer price as a fraction of retail price. minMultiplier (0.88) leaves headroom; maxMultiplier (1.0) keeps offers competitive while preserving importer margin.

items.label: Ex Works
items.description: Buyer takes title at the seller's premises and bears all subsequent freight, insurance, customs, and delivery costs.

items.label: Free Carrier
items.description: Seller delivers goods cleared for export to a named carrier or place. Buyer takes responsibility from that point onward.

items.label: Carriage Paid To
items.description: Seller pays for carriage to the named destination. Risk transfers to the buyer once goods are handed to the first carrier. Any mode of transport.

items.label: Carriage and Insurance Paid To
items.description: As CPT, but seller also pays for insurance covering the buyer's risk during carriage. Insurance must be at the higher (all-risks) ICC A level. Any mode of transport.

items.label: Delivered at Place
items.description: Seller pays to deliver goods to the named destination. Buyer handles import clearance, duties, and taxes unless otherwise agreed.

items.label: Delivered at Place Unloaded
items.description: Seller delivers and unloads goods at the named destination. Buyer handles import clearance and duties/taxes.

items.label: Delivered Duty Paid
items.description: Seller bears nearly all costs and risks, including import duties and taxes, until goods are delivered to the buyer.

items.label: Free Alongside Ship
items.description: Seller delivers when goods are placed alongside the named vessel at the port of shipment. Risk transfers at that point. Sea/inland-waterway only.

items.label: Free On Board
items.description: Seller delivers goods loaded onto the named vessel at the port of shipment; risk transfers once on board. Sea/inland-waterway only.

items.label: Cost and Freight
items.description: Seller pays transport to the destination port. Risk transfers to the buyer once goods are loaded at origin. Sea/inland-waterway only.

items.label: Cost, Insurance and Freight
items.description: As CFR, but seller also pays marine insurance to the destination port. Risk still transfers at shipment. Sea/inland-waterway only.

items.label: Landed Price
items.description: Informal commercial term: product cost including freight, duties, and related import costs up to arrival in market. Scope should always be clarified between parties.

items.label: Warehouse Price
items.description: Price for goods delivered into a specified warehouse. Common in commercial discussions; not a formal Incoterm.

items.label: Net/net Price
items.description: Final price after discounts, rebates, or commissions. Common in distributor and importer negotiations.

items.label: Gross Price
items.description: List price before discounts, rebates, promotional support, or other deductions.
